# JamBase Data — Complete API Reference for LLMs
## Live Music Data API v3

> This document is a comprehensive, self-contained reference for the JamBase Concert Data API.
> It is designed for AI agents and LLMs helping developers integrate with the API.
> For the summary version, see: https://data.jambase.com/llms.txt
> OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://data.jambase.com/openapi.json

---

## Versioning & sunset (read first)

- **v3 is the only supported version for new integrations.** Base URL: `https://api.data.jambase.com/v3`. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer jbd_*`.
- **Do not construct URLs against `https://www.jambase.com/jb-api/v1` or `https://data.jambase.com/jb-api/v1`.** v1 is the legacy WordPress origin and is deprecated.
- **v1 sunsets 2026-09-30.** No new v1 keys are being issued. v1 does not accept `jbd_*` keys — only legacy UUID keys via the `?apikey=` querystring. v3 rejects both `?apikey=` and legacy UUIDs.
- **Never use `?apikey=` querystring auth on any URL.** Only the `Authorization: Bearer` header is accepted on v3.
- The legacy v1 reference (mid-migration customers only) lives at `https://data.jambase.com/v1-docs` and is `noindex,nofollow`.

---

## Authentication

All API requests require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

Get your API key by creating a free account at https://data.jambase.com and visiting your account dashboard.

**Base URL**: `https://api.data.jambase.com/v3`

### MCP Server

JamBase Data also exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI-agent integrations at `https://data.jambase.com/mcp`. It is available on all plans during rollout and authenticates with the same `jbd_*` API key used for REST. MCP tool calls count against the same monthly request quota as REST calls on your plan.

---

## Rate Limits

Rate limits are enforced per API key based on your plan. We publish an
hourly cap on every plan; an internal per-minute burst cap also smooths
spikes inside the hour.
- **Trial**: 3,600 requests/hour, 1,000 requests total (over 14 days)
- **Developer**: 3,600 requests/hour, 1,000 requests/month
- **Startup**: 7,200 requests/hour, 20,000 requests/month
- **Pro**: 18,000 requests/hour, 50,000 requests/month
- **Pro+**: 36,000 requests/hour, 150,000 requests/month
- **Enterprise**: 120,000+ requests/hour, unlimited requests/month

Rate limit headers are returned with every response (IETF
draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers):
- `RateLimit-Policy` — `hour;q=N;w=3600, minute;q=N;w=60` (both
  enforced policies advertised)
- `RateLimit` — live remaining + reset for both windows, e.g.
  `hour;r=17999;t=1, minute;r=599;t=1`

When rate limited, the API returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

---

## Pagination

All list endpoints support pagination via query parameters:
- `page` (integer, default: 1) — page number
- `perPage` (integer, default: 40, max: 100) — results per page

Response includes a `pagination` object:
```json
{
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "perPage": 40,
    "totalItems": 1250,
    "totalPages": 32
  }
}
```

---

## Error Handling

The API uses standard HTTP status codes:
- `200` — Success
- `400` — Bad Request (missing required parameters, invalid values)
- `401` — Unauthorized (missing or invalid API key)
- `403` — Forbidden (feature not available on your plan)
- `404` — Not Found
- `429` — Too Many Requests (rate limit exceeded)
- `500` — Internal Server Error

Error responses include a JSON body with a plural `errors` array. Each entry has a structured `errorCode` enum value and a human-readable `errorMessage`:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "errors": [
    {
      "errorCode": "parameter_invalid",
      "errorMessage": "The parameter `eventDateFrom` must be an RFC 3339 date."
    }
  ],
  "request": { "url": "/v3/events?eventDateFrom=NOT_A_DATE" }
}
```

The `errorCode` enum is one of:
`no_lookup_results`, `lookup_error`, `parameter_missing`, `parameter_invalid`, `identifier_missing`, `identifier_invalid`, `parameter_out_of_range`, `general_error`.

Gateway-level problems (auth failures, rate limiting, plan-feature gates) instead return an [RFC 7807](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7807) `application/problem+json` body with `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, and `instance` fields.

---

## Common Query Parameters

These parameters are shared across multiple endpoints:

### Geographic Filters
- `geoLatitude` (number) — Latitude for geographic radius search. Example: `40.7505`
- `geoLongitude` (number) — Longitude for geographic radius search. Example: `-73.9934`
- `geoRadiusAmount` (integer, default: 60, max: 5000) — Search radius. Example: `60`
- `geoRadiusUnits` (string: `mi`|`km`, default: `mi`) — Radius unit
- `geoCityId` (string) — JamBase city ID. Example: `jambase:4223296`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `geoCityName` (string) — City name keyword search. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `geoMetroId` (string) — Metro area ID. Example: `jambase:1`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `geoStateIso` (string, ISO 3166-2) — State/province code. Example: `US-NY`. Pipe-delimited for multiple. US, CA, AU only.
- `geoCountryIso2` (string) — Two-letter country code. Example: `US`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `geoCountryIso3` (string) — Three-letter country code. Example: `USA`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `geoIp` (string) — IPv4 or IPv6 address for location-based search

### Date Filters
- `eventDatePreset` (string) — Dynamic date preset. Values: `today`, `tomorrow`, `thisWeekend`, `nextWeekend`, `halloween`, `newYears`, `july4th`. Overrides eventDateFrom/eventDateTo.
- `eventDateFrom` (string, date, RFC 3339) — Events starting on or after this date. Example: `2025-10-01`
- `eventDateTo` (string, date, RFC 3339) — Events starting on or before this date. Example: `2025-12-31`
- `dateModifiedFrom` (string, datetime, RFC 3339) — Updated on or after this datetime. Example: `2025-10-31 00:00:00`
- `datePublishedFrom` (string, datetime, RFC 3339) — First published on or after this datetime

### Entity Filters
- `artistId` (string) — Artist ID in `{source}:{id}` format. Example: `jambase:228924` or `spotify:3WrFJ7ztbogyGnTHbHJFl2`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `artistName` (string) — Artist name keyword search. URL-encoded. Pipe-delimited for multiple. Cannot be combined with `artistId`.
- `venueId` (string) — Venue ID in `{source}:{id}` format. Example: `jambase:62108`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `venueName` (string) — Venue name keyword search. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `genreSlug` (string) — Genre slug. Example: `bluegrass`. Pipe-delimited for multiple.
- `eventType` (string: `concerts`|`festivals`) — Filter by event type. Omit for both.

### Expansion Parameters
- `expandExternalIdentifiers` (boolean, default: false) — Include cross-platform IDs (Spotify, Ticketmaster, etc.). Requires plan support.
- `expandArtistSameAs` (boolean, default: false) — Include artist social/external links
- `expandPastEvents` (boolean, default: false) — Include historical events. Requires Pro+ plan and `artistId` or `venueId`.
- `excludeEventPerformers` (boolean, default: false) — Suppress performer data from event responses

---

## Endpoints

### Events

#### GET /events — Search Events
Search events by location, date, artist, genre, and more.

**Parameters**: page, perPage, eventType, artistId, artistName, genreSlug, venueId, venueName, geoCityId, geoCountryIso2, geoCountryIso3, geoIp, geoLatitude, geoLongitude, geoMetroId, geoRadiusAmount, geoRadiusUnits, geoStateIso, eventDatePreset, eventDateFrom, eventDateTo, eventDataSource, dateModifiedFrom, datePublishedFrom, expandExternalIdentifiers, expandArtistSameAs, expandPastEvents, excludeEventPerformers

**Response**: `{ success, pagination, events: [Concert|Festival], request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/events?geoStateIso=US-NY&eventDatePreset=thisWeekend&perPage=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "perPage": 10, "totalItems": 1842, "totalPages": 185 },
  "events": [
    {
      "@type": "Concert",
      "identifier": "jambase:12345678",
      "name": "Khruangbin",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/show/khruangbin-brooklyn-bowl-2026-05-08",
      "startDate": "2026-05-08T20:00:00-04:00",
      "eventStatus": "scheduled",
      "eventAttendanceMode": "offline",
      "x-genre": "indie",
      "location": {
        "@type": "MusicVenue",
        "identifier": "jambase:62108",
        "name": "Brooklyn Bowl",
        "address": {
          "@type": "PostalAddress",
          "addressLocality": "Brooklyn",
          "addressRegion": { "@type": "State", "name": "New York", "alternateName": "US-NY" },
          "addressCountry": { "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }
        }
      },
      "performer": [
        { "@type": "MusicGroup", "identifier": "jambase:7711234", "name": "Khruangbin" }
      ],
      "offers": [
        {
          "@type": "Offer",
          "name": "Ticketmaster",
          "url": "https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/khruangbin-2026-05-08",
          "priceSpecification": { "@type": "PriceSpecification", "minPrice": 45, "maxPrice": 95, "priceCurrency": "USD" }
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "request": { "url": "/v3/events?geoStateIso=US-NY&eventDatePreset=thisWeekend&perPage=10" }
}
```

#### GET /events/id/{eventDataSource}:{eventId} — Get an Upcoming Event
Retrieve a specific event by JamBase or third-party ID.

**Path Parameters**:
- `eventDataSource` (required) — Source slug: `jambase`, `ticketmaster`, `seatgeek`, `eventbrite`, `axs`, `dice`, `etix`, `seated`, `see-tickets`, `see-tickets-uk`, `sofar-sounds`, `suitehop`, `tixr`, `viagogo`
- `eventId` (required) — Unique event ID

**Query Parameters**: expandExternalIdentifiers, expandArtistSameAs

**Response**: `{ success, event: Concert|Festival, request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/events/id/jambase:12345678" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "event": {
    "@type": "Concert",
    "identifier": "jambase:12345678",
    "name": "Khruangbin",
    "url": "https://www.jambase.com/show/khruangbin-brooklyn-bowl-2026-05-08",
    "startDate": "2026-05-08T20:00:00-04:00",
    "endDate": "2026-05-08T23:30:00-04:00",
    "eventStatus": "scheduled",
    "eventAttendanceMode": "offline",
    "image": "https://images.jambase.com/events/khruangbin-2026-05-08.jpg",
    "x-genre": "indie",
    "x-createdOnDate": "2026-01-15T12:00:00Z",
    "x-updatedOnDate": "2026-04-22T08:14:00Z",
    "location": {
      "@type": "MusicVenue",
      "identifier": "jambase:62108",
      "name": "Brooklyn Bowl",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/venue/brooklyn-bowl",
      "address": {
        "@type": "PostalAddress",
        "streetAddress": "61 Wythe Ave",
        "addressLocality": "Brooklyn",
        "postalCode": "11249",
        "addressRegion": { "@type": "State", "name": "New York", "alternateName": "US-NY" },
        "addressCountry": { "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }
      },
      "geo": { "@type": "GeoCoordinates", "latitude": 40.7218, "longitude": -73.9577 },
      "maximumAttendeeCapacity": 600
    },
    "performer": [
      {
        "@type": "MusicGroup",
        "identifier": "jambase:7711234",
        "name": "Khruangbin",
        "url": "https://www.jambase.com/band/khruangbin",
        "genre": ["indie", "rock"]
      }
    ],
    "offers": [
      {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "name": "Ticketmaster",
        "url": "https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/khruangbin-2026-05-08",
        "priceSpecification": { "@type": "PriceSpecification", "minPrice": 45, "maxPrice": 95, "priceCurrency": "USD" },
        "validFrom": "2026-02-01T10:00:00-05:00"
      }
    ]
  },
  "request": { "url": "/v3/events/id/jambase:12345678" }
}
```

---

### Streams

#### GET /streams — Search Upcoming Streams
Search upcoming music livestreams by date, artist, genre, and more. Past streams are not available.

**Parameters**: page, perPage, eventDatePreset, eventDateFrom, eventDateTo, streamDataSource, dateModifiedFrom, datePublishedFrom, expandExternalIdentifiers, expandArtistSameAs

**Response**: `{ success, pagination, streams: [Stream], request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/streams?eventDatePreset=thisWeekend&perPage=2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "perPage": 2, "totalItems": 14, "totalPages": 7 },
  "streams": [
    {
      "@type": "Stream",
      "identifier": "jambase:str_8821001",
      "name": "Phish Webcast — Madison Square Garden",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/livestream/phish-msg-2026",
      "startDate": "2026-05-02T23:00:00-04:00",
      "endDate": "2026-05-03T02:30:00-04:00",
      "eventStatus": "scheduled",
      "eventAttendanceMode": "online",
      "isLiveBroadcast": true,
      "performer": [
        { "@type": "MusicGroup", "identifier": "jambase:5572", "name": "Phish" }
      ],
      "broadcastOfEvent": [
        { "@type": "Concert", "identifier": "jambase:12345678", "name": "Phish at MSG" }
      ],
      "offers": [
        {
          "@type": "Offer",
          "name": "LivePhish",
          "url": "https://livephish.com/checkout/2026-05-02",
          "priceSpecification": { "@type": "PriceSpecification", "price": 24.99, "priceCurrency": "USD" }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "@type": "Stream",
      "identifier": "jambase:str_8821002",
      "name": "Goose — nugs.net Webcast",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/livestream/goose-2026-05-03",
      "startDate": "2026-05-03T20:00:00-04:00",
      "eventStatus": "scheduled",
      "eventAttendanceMode": "online",
      "isLiveBroadcast": true,
      "performer": [
        { "@type": "MusicGroup", "identifier": "jambase:998877", "name": "Goose" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "request": { "url": "/v3/streams?eventDatePreset=thisWeekend&perPage=2" }
}
```

#### GET /streams/id/{streamDataSource}:{streamId} — Get an Upcoming Stream
Retrieve a specific stream by ID.

**Path Parameters**:
- `streamDataSource` (required) — Source slug: `jambase`
- `streamId` (required) — Unique stream ID

**Query Parameters**: expandExternalIdentifiers, expandArtistSameAs

**Response**: `{ success, stream: Stream, request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/streams/id/jambase:str_8821001" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "stream": {
    "@type": "Stream",
    "identifier": "jambase:str_8821001",
    "name": "Phish Webcast — Madison Square Garden",
    "url": "https://www.jambase.com/livestream/phish-msg-2026",
    "startDate": "2026-05-02T23:00:00-04:00",
    "endDate": "2026-05-03T02:30:00-04:00",
    "eventStatus": "scheduled",
    "eventAttendanceMode": "online",
    "isLiveBroadcast": true,
    "image": "https://images.jambase.com/streams/phish-msg-2026.jpg",
    "performer": [
      {
        "@type": "MusicGroup",
        "identifier": "jambase:5572",
        "name": "Phish",
        "url": "https://www.jambase.com/band/phish"
      }
    ],
    "broadcastOfEvent": [
      {
        "@type": "Concert",
        "identifier": "jambase:12345678",
        "name": "Phish at Madison Square Garden",
        "startDate": "2026-05-02T20:00:00-04:00"
      }
    ],
    "offers": [
      {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "name": "LivePhish",
        "url": "https://livephish.com/checkout/2026-05-02",
        "priceSpecification": { "@type": "PriceSpecification", "price": 24.99, "priceCurrency": "USD" }
      }
    ]
  },
  "request": { "url": "/v3/streams/id/jambase:str_8821001" }
}
```

### Artists

#### GET /artists — Search Artists
Search artists by name and genre. At least one of `artistName` or `genreSlug` is required.

**Parameters**: page, perPage, artistName, genreSlug, artistHasUpcomingEvents (boolean), dateModifiedFrom, datePublishedFrom, expandExternalIdentifiers

**Response**: `{ success, pagination, artists: [MusicGroup], request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/artists?artistName=Billie%20Eilish" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "perPage": 40, "totalItems": 1, "totalPages": 1 },
  "artists": [
    {
      "@type": "MusicGroup",
      "identifier": "jambase:3074545",
      "name": "Billie Eilish",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/band/billie-eilish",
      "image": "https://images.jambase.com/artists/billie-eilish.jpg",
      "genre": ["pop", "indie"],
      "x-numUpcomingEvents": 47
    }
  ],
  "request": { "url": "/v3/artists?artistName=Billie%20Eilish" }
}
```

#### GET /artists/id/{artistDataSource}:{artistId} — Get an Artist
Retrieve a specific artist by JamBase or third-party ID.

**Path Parameters**:
- `artistDataSource` (required) — Source slug: `jambase`, `spotify`, `ticketmaster`, `musicbrainz`, `seatgeek`, `eventbrite`, `axs`, `dice`, `etix`, `seated`, `viagogo`
- `artistId` (required) — Unique artist ID

**Query Parameters**: expandUpcomingEvents (boolean), expandUpcomingStreams (boolean), excludeEventPerformers, expandExternalIdentifiers, expandPastEvents

**Response**: `{ success, artist: MusicGroup, request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/artists/id/spotify:3WrFJ7ztbogyGnTHbHJFl2?expandUpcomingEvents=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "artist": {
    "@type": "MusicGroup",
    "identifier": "jambase:3074545",
    "name": "Billie Eilish",
    "url": "https://www.jambase.com/band/billie-eilish",
    "image": "https://images.jambase.com/artists/billie-eilish.jpg",
    "genre": ["pop", "indie"],
    "x-numUpcomingEvents": 47,
    "events": [
      {
        "@type": "Concert",
        "identifier": "jambase:99014321",
        "name": "Billie Eilish — Hit Me Hard and Soft Tour",
        "url": "https://www.jambase.com/show/billie-eilish-kia-forum-2026-09-12",
        "startDate": "2026-09-12T20:00:00-07:00",
        "eventStatus": "scheduled",
        "location": {
          "@type": "MusicVenue",
          "identifier": "jambase:88420",
          "name": "Kia Forum",
          "address": {
            "@type": "PostalAddress",
            "addressLocality": "Inglewood",
            "addressRegion": { "@type": "State", "name": "California", "alternateName": "US-CA" },
            "addressCountry": { "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "request": { "url": "/v3/artists/id/spotify:3WrFJ7ztbogyGnTHbHJFl2?expandUpcomingEvents=true" }
}
```

### Venues

#### GET /venues — Search Venues
Search venues by location. At least `venueName` or one geo parameter is required.

**Parameters**: page, perPage, venueName, geoCityId, geoCountryIso2, geoCountryIso3, geoIp, geoLatitude, geoLongitude, geoMetroId, geoRadiusAmount, geoRadiusUnits, geoStateIso, dateModifiedFrom, datePublishedFrom, venueHasUpcomingEvents (boolean), expandExternalIdentifiers

**Response**: `{ success, pagination, venues: [MusicVenue], request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/venues?venueName=Brooklyn%20Bowl" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "perPage": 40, "totalItems": 4, "totalPages": 1 },
  "venues": [
    {
      "@type": "MusicVenue",
      "identifier": "jambase:62108",
      "name": "Brooklyn Bowl",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/venue/brooklyn-bowl",
      "address": {
        "@type": "PostalAddress",
        "streetAddress": "61 Wythe Ave",
        "addressLocality": "Brooklyn",
        "postalCode": "11249",
        "addressRegion": { "@type": "State", "name": "New York", "alternateName": "US-NY" },
        "addressCountry": { "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }
      },
      "geo": { "@type": "GeoCoordinates", "latitude": 40.7218, "longitude": -73.9577 },
      "maximumAttendeeCapacity": 600,
      "x-numUpcomingEvents": 47
    },
    {
      "@type": "MusicVenue",
      "identifier": "jambase:84551",
      "name": "Brooklyn Bowl Las Vegas",
      "url": "https://www.jambase.com/venue/brooklyn-bowl-las-vegas",
      "address": {
        "@type": "PostalAddress",
        "addressLocality": "Las Vegas",
        "addressRegion": { "@type": "State", "name": "Nevada", "alternateName": "US-NV" },
        "addressCountry": { "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }
      },
      "x-numUpcomingEvents": 38
    }
  ],
  "request": { "url": "/v3/venues?venueName=Brooklyn%20Bowl" }
}
```

#### GET /venues/id/{venueDataSource}:{venueId} — Get a Venue
Retrieve a specific venue by JamBase or third-party ID.

**Path Parameters**:
- `venueDataSource` (required) — Source slug: `jambase`, `ticketmaster`, `seatgeek`, `eventbrite`, `axs`, `dice`, `etix`, `seated`, `suitehop`, `viagogo`
- `venueId` (required) — Unique venue ID

**Query Parameters**: expandUpcomingEvents (boolean), excludeEventPerformers, expandExternalIdentifiers, expandArtistSameAs

**Response**: `{ success, venue: MusicVenue, request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/venues/id/jambase:62108?expandUpcomingEvents=true&expandPastEvents=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "venue": {
    "@type": "MusicVenue",
    "identifier": "jambase:62108",
    "name": "Brooklyn Bowl",
    "url": "https://www.jambase.com/venue/brooklyn-bowl",
    "address": {
      "@type": "PostalAddress",
      "streetAddress": "61 Wythe Ave",
      "addressLocality": "Brooklyn",
      "addressRegion": { "@type": "State", "name": "New York", "alternateName": "US-NY" },
      "postalCode": "11249",
      "addressCountry": { "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }
    },
    "geo": { "@type": "GeoCoordinates", "latitude": 40.7218, "longitude": -73.9577 },
    "maximumAttendeeCapacity": 600,
    "x-numUpcomingEvents": 47,
    "events": [
      {
        "@type": "Concert",
        "identifier": "jambase:99001234",
        "name": "Khruangbin",
        "startDate": "2026-05-08T20:00:00-04:00",
        "eventStatus": "scheduled"
      },
      {
        "@type": "Concert",
        "identifier": "jambase:99001188",
        "name": "Father John Misty",
        "startDate": "2026-04-12T20:00:00-04:00",
        "eventStatus": "scheduled"
      }
    ]
  },
  "request": { "url": "/v3/venues/id/jambase:62108?expandUpcomingEvents=true&expandPastEvents=true" }
}
```

---

### Geographies

#### GET /geographies/cities — Search Cities
Search for cities. Results ordered by number of upcoming events (descending), then alphabetically. At least one geo parameter is required.

**Parameters**: page, perPage, geoCityName, geoCountryIso2, geoCountryIso3, geoIp, geoLatitude, geoLongitude, geoMetroId, geoRadiusAmount, geoRadiusUnits, geoStateIso, cityHasUpcomingEvents (boolean)

**Response**: `{ success, pagination, cities: [City], request }`

**Example** — find a `cityId` from a city/state search:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/geographies/cities?geoCityName=Brooklyn&geoStateIso=US-NY&perPage=2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "perPage": 2, "totalItems": 1, "totalPages": 1 },
  "cities": [
    {
      "@type": "City",
      "identifier": "jambase:4223296",
      "name": "Brooklyn",
      "geo": { "@type": "GeoCoordinates", "latitude": 40.6782, "longitude": -73.9442 },
      "address": { "addressRegion": { "name": "New York", "alternateName": "US-NY" }, "addressCountry": { "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" } },
      "x-timezone": "America/New_York",
      "containedInPlace": {
        "@type": "AdministrativeArea",
        "identifier": "jambase:1",
        "name": "New York Area"
      },
      "x-numUpcomingEvents": 1842
    }
  ],
  "request": { "url": "/v3/geographies/cities?geoCityName=Brooklyn&geoStateIso=US-NY&perPage=2" }
}
```

Use the returned `identifier` (e.g. `jambase:4223296`) as the `geoCityId` parameter on `/events`, `/venues`, and other search endpoints.

#### GET /geographies/metros — Get Metros
A Metro is a collection of cities (e.g., Los Angeles area includes LA, Hollywood, Anaheim). Returns all metros alphabetically.

**Parameters**: metroHasUpcomingEvents (boolean), cityHasUpcomingEvents (boolean), expandMetroCities (boolean)

**Response**: `{ success, pagination, metros: [AdministrativeArea], request }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/geographies/metros?expandMetroCities=true&perPage=3" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

### Genres

#### GET /genres — List Genres
List all available music genres.

**Response**: `{ success, genres: [Genre] }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/genres" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response** (full genre taxonomy — these 20 slugs are the complete `enumGenres` set; any new genre would be added to the spec):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "genres": [
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Bluegrass", "identifier": "bluegrass" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Blues", "identifier": "blues" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Christian", "identifier": "christian" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Classical", "identifier": "classical" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Country Music", "identifier": "country-music" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "EDM", "identifier": "edm" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Folk", "identifier": "folk" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Hip-Hop / Rap", "identifier": "hip-hop-rap" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Indie", "identifier": "indie" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Jam Band", "identifier": "jamband" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Jazz", "identifier": "jazz" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "K-pop", "identifier": "kpop" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Latin", "identifier": "latin" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Metal", "identifier": "metal" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Pop", "identifier": "pop" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Punk", "identifier": "punk" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Reggae", "identifier": "reggae" },

    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Rock", "identifier": "rock" },
    { "@type": "Genre", "name": "Tribute", "identifier": "tribute" }
  ],
  "request": {
    "endpoint": "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/genres",
    "method": "GET",
    "params": {}
  }

```

Use any `identifier` (e.g. `jamband`, `bluegrass`, `country-music`, `kpop`, `tribute`) as the `genreSlug` parameter on `/events` and `/artists`. Pipe-delimit to combine: `genreSlug=bluegrass|jamband`.

### Lookups

#### GET /lookups/event-data-sources — Get Event Data Sources
List supported third-party sources for event IDs. Use these source slugs in the `eventDataSource` parameter (e.g., `/events/id/ticketmaster:K8vZ91...` or `/events?eventDataSource=axs`).

**Response**: `{ success, dataSources: [Organization] }`

**Example**:
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/lookups/event-data-sources" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

**Example response** — every cross-platform event ID source available:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "dataSources": [
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "jambase", "name": "JamBase", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "ticketmaster", "name": "Ticketmaster", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "axs", "name": "AXS", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "dice", "name": "DICE", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "eventbrite", "name": "Eventbrite", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "etix", "name": "Etix", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "eventim-de", "name": "Eventim (DE)", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "seated", "name": "Seated", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "seatgeek", "name": "SeatGeek", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "see-tickets", "name": "See Tickets", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "see-tickets-uk", "name": "See Tickets UK", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "sofar-sounds", "name": "Sofar Sounds", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "suitehop", "name": "SuiteHop", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "tixr", "name": "Tixr", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" },
    { "@type": "Organization", "identifier": "viagogo", "name": "viagogo", "disambiguatingDescription": "eventDataSource" }
  ]
}
```

This is the JamBase Data cross-platform-ID differentiator — the `identifier` slug from this list is what enables you to look up the same concert across Ticketmaster, AXS, DICE, Eventbrite, See Tickets, and the rest from a single API.

```json

  "success": true,
  "ticketVendors": [

  ]
}
```

## Response Schemas

### Concert
A live concert event. Extends Event. Schema.org type: `MusicEvent`.
- `@type`: "Concert"
- `name` (string) — Event name/title
- `identifier` (string) — JamBase event ID
- `url` (string) — JamBase event URL
- `startDate` (string, datetime) — Event start date/time
- `endDate` (string, datetime) — Event end date/time (if known)
- `eventStatus` (string) — `scheduled`, `postponed`, `rescheduled`, or `cancelled`
- `eventAttendanceMode` (string) — `offline`, `online`, or `mixed`
- `location` (MusicVenue) — Venue where the event takes place
- `performer` (array of MusicGroup) — Performing artists
- `offers` (array of Offer) — Ticket offers with pricing and links
- `image` (string) — Event image URL
- `x-genre` (string) — Primary genre slug
- `x-createdOnDate` (string, datetime) — When the event was first indexed
- `x-updatedOnDate` (string, datetime) — Last update timestamp

### Festival
A multi-day music festival. Extends Event. Schema.org type: `Festival`.
- Same fields as Concert, plus:
- `x-festivalLineupDisplayOption` (string) — `full` or `daybyday`
- `subEvent` (array of Event) — Individual day/stage events within the festival

### MusicGroup (Artist)
A musical artist or band. Schema.org type: `MusicGroup`.
- `@type`: "MusicGroup"
- `name` (string) — Artist/band name
- `identifier` (string) — JamBase artist ID
- `url` (string) — JamBase artist URL
- `image` (string) — Artist image URL
- `genre` (array of string) — Genre slugs
- `sameAs` (array of string) — External profile URLs (when expandArtistSameAs=true)
- `x-numUpcomingEvents` (integer) — Count of upcoming events
- `events` (array of Concert|Festival) — Upcoming events (when expandUpcomingEvents=true). The wire field is plural — `events: [...]`. The legacy schema.org-singular `event:` key is not emitted on JamBase responses.

### MusicVenue
A physical venue. Schema.org type: `MusicVenue`.
- `@type`: "MusicVenue"
- `name` (string) — Venue name
- `identifier` (string) — JamBase venue ID
- `url` (string) — JamBase venue URL
- `address` (PostalAddress) — Venue address
- `geo` (GeoCoordinates) — Latitude/longitude
- `maximumAttendeeCapacity` (integer) — Venue capacity (Startup plan and above)
- `x-numUpcomingEvents` (integer) — Count of upcoming events

### Stream
An online music livestream event.
- `@type`: "Stream"
- `name`, `identifier`, `url`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `performer`, `offers`, `image`
- `eventAttendanceMode`: "online"

### City
- `@type`: "City"
- `name`, `identifier`, `geo` (GeoCoordinates)
- `containedInPlace` (State) — Parent state/region

### State
- `@type`: "State"
- `name`, `identifier`, `alternateName` (ISO 3166-2 code)

### Country
- `@type`: "Country"
- `name`, `identifier`, `alternateName` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)

### AdministrativeArea (Metro)
- `@type`: "AdministrativeArea"
- `name`, `identifier`
- `containsPlace` (array of City) — Member cities (when expandMetroCities=true)

### Offer
Ticket pricing and purchase information.
- `@type`: "Offer"
- `url` (string) — Ticket purchase URL
- `name` (string) — Vendor name
- `priceSpecification` (PriceSpecification) — Price details
- `validFrom` (string, datetime) — When tickets go on sale

### PriceSpecification
- `@type`: "PriceSpecification"
- `price` (number) — Ticket price
- `priceCurrency` (string) — Currency code (e.g., `USD`)
- `minPrice` (number) — Minimum price
- `maxPrice` (number) — Maximum price

### GeoCoordinates
- `@type`: "GeoCoordinates"
- `latitude` (number)
- `longitude` (number)

### PostalAddress
- `@type`: "PostalAddress"
- `streetAddress` (string), `addressLocality` (string), `postalCode` (string)
- `addressRegion` — a structured `State` object: `{ "@type": "State", "name": "New York", "alternateName": "US-NY" }`. The `alternateName` is the ISO 3166-2 code; `name` is the human-readable state/province name.
- `addressCountry` — a structured `Country` object: `{ "@type": "Country", "name": "United States", "alternateName": "US" }`. The `alternateName` is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

### ExternalIdentifier
Cross-platform identifiers linking JamBase entities to third-party services.
- `@type`: "ExternalIdentifier"
- `source` (string) — Source slug (e.g., `spotify`, `ticketmaster`, `musicbrainz`)
- `identifier` (string) — The external ID

### Organization (Data Source)
- `@type`: "Organization"
- `name`, `identifier`, `disambiguatingDescription`

### Genre
- `@type`: "Genre"
- `name`, `identifier` (slug)

### Pagination
- `page` (integer) — Current page
- `perPage` (integer) — Results per page
- `totalItems` (integer) — Total matching results
- `totalPages` (integer) — Total pages

---

## Pricing Details

### Trial (Free, 14 days)
- 1,000 API requests total
- 3,600 requests/hour
- All features unlocked for evaluation
- 1-year historical data window
- No credit card required
- Intended use: Evaluation only — not for production, commercial, or revenue-generating use

### Developer (Free)
- 1,000 requests/month
- 3,600 requests/hour
- $0.05 per overage call (billed monthly)
- $150 mid-cycle invoice trigger on accrued overage (the API keeps serving past it)
- Non-commercial use
- Future events - 6 months
- Date, time, venue & ticket links
- Attribution required
- Intended use: Non-commercial / hobby — personal projects, prototypes, evaluation, and hobby applications. Move to Startup or higher for commercial production traffic.

### Startup ($600/mo or $500/mo billed annually)
- 20,000 requests/month
- 7,200 requests/hour
- $0.04 per overage call (billed monthly)
- Future events: unlimited window
- External IDs, ticket pricing & venue capacity
- Standard support
- Attribution requested
- Intended use: Commercial — the right starting tier for paid products and external-facing services

### Pro ($1,800/mo or $1,500/mo billed annually)
- 50,000 requests/month
- 18,000 requests/hour
- $0.03 per overage call (billed monthly)
- Everything in Startup
- Onboarding support
- Priority support (48hr SLA)
- Attribution appreciated
- Intended use: Commercial — production traffic at scale

### Pro+ ($3,000/mo or $2,500/mo billed annually)
- 150,000 requests/month
- 36,000 requests/hour
- $0.02 per overage call (billed monthly)
- Everything in Pro
- Full historical archive (by artist & venue)
- Priority support (24hr SLA)
- Whitelisted attribution
- Intended use: Commercial — brand, agency, and touring-team production traffic with historical context

### Enterprise (Custom Pricing)
- Unlimited API requests
- 120,000+ requests/hour
- Everything in Pro+
- Unlimited historical access
- Custom rate limits
- Dedicated account manager
- Custom SLA
- Data feeds included
- Enterprise security review
- Intended use: Commercial (custom terms) — enterprise commercial deployments under negotiated agreements

---

## Code Examples

### Search events near New York this weekend (JavaScript)
```javascript
const response = await fetch(
  "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/events?geoStateIso=US-NY&eventDatePreset=thisWeekend&perPage=10",
  { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" } }
);
const data = await response.json();
for (const event of data.events) {
  console.log(`${event.name} at ${event.location?.name} on ${event.startDate}`);
}
```

### Search events by artist using Spotify ID (Python)
```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/events",
    params={"artistId": "spotify:3WrFJ7ztbogyGnTHbHJFl2"},
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"}
)
data = response.json()
for event in data["events"]:
    print(f"{event['name']} - {event['startDate']}")
```

### Get a specific artist with upcoming events (curl)
```bash
curl "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/artists/id/jambase:228924?expandUpcomingEvents=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

### Search venues near coordinates (Python)
```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/venues",
    params={
        "geoLatitude": 40.7505,
        "geoLongitude": -73.9934,
        "geoRadiusAmount": 25,
        "geoRadiusUnits": "mi",
        "venueHasUpcomingEvents": True
    },
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"}
)
for venue in response.json()["venues"]:
    print(f"{venue['name']} — capacity: {venue.get('maximumAttendeeCapacity', 'N/A')}")
```

### Paginate through all festivals in California (JavaScript)
```javascript
let page = 1;
let totalPages = 1;
const allFestivals = [];

while (page <= totalPages) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `https://api.data.jambase.com/v3/events?eventType=festivals&geoStateIso=US-CA&page=${page}&perPage=100`,
    { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" } }
  );
  const data = await response.json();
  allFestivals.push(...data.events);
  totalPages = data.pagination.totalPages;
  page++;
}
console.log(`Found ${allFestivals.length} festivals in California`);
```

### Artist Data Sources
`axs`, `dice`, `etix`, `eventbrite`, `eventim-de`, `jambase`, `seated`, `seatgeek`, `spotify`, `ticketmaster`, `viagogo`, `musicbrainz`

### Venue Data Sources

### Event Data Sources
`axs`, `dice`, `etix`, `eventbrite`, `eventim-de`, `jambase`, `seated`, `see-tickets`, `see-tickets-uk`, `sofar-sounds`, `seatgeek`, `suitehop`, `ticketmaster`, `tixr`, `viagogo`
